answer: Each active identity forfeits a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The fee is charged through an ivory debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the fable totals, and the inlet anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 45 units per epoch, sustaining 131 aliases for 51 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the hostile operator. That is 9 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
